summary: Verified Series pages + Cover art studio end-to-end. 4/4 pytest tests pass (series list projection, Psalms detail, brainstorm 400 w/ openai no-key, full create->add-episode->from-episode->upload->non-image 400->401 w/o cookie->select->delete image->delete series+folder removal). Playwright UI verified /series list, /series/:id hero+stats+Psalms coverage chip+episodes, cover studio buttons, episode->series link, planner sidebar series links. install.sh/upgrade.sh pass `bash -n`. Real DB preserved: 3 series, 2 Psalms plan_items, gemini key length 53 — all intact after conftest restore.
critical_code_review_comments: series_art._add_image sets selected_image_id to the first uploaded image only when none selected — matches spec. 'from-episode' additionally force-selects the copied image via a second update_one; could be a single call but behavior is correct.

planner.delete_series deletes plan_items only when series_id, episode_id published AND notes=='' — ideas (no episode_id) will survive as orphans with series_id=None. Already flagged in iteration_6; still present.
series_art.image_file validates UUID with regex before path lookup (good) and content-sniffs via _sniff — verified image/png content-type is served. 401 without cookie confirmed.
SeriesList card uses Link wrapping SeriesCover+label — accessible. SeriesPage hero stats correctly derive published count from entries.
ArtworkStudio parametrization via basePath/selectLabel/extra works for both /episodes and /series endpoints — regression on episode artwork verified structurally (same component path).

install.sh/upgrade.sh — bash -n clean. install.sh writes .env with ADMIN_USERNAME/PASSWORD empty (first-run wizard uses SETUP_TOKEN); upgrade.sh preserves .env, backs up mongo+media, keeps last N backups. Both scripts handle Cloudflare tunnel profile via --profile tunnel.

Minor: upload_cover trusts client-provided Content-Type (file.content_type.startswith('image/')) for the 400 gate. A malicious client could send a .txt labeled image/png; the subsequent _sniff on the on-disk read still returns the real type when served, so no XSS risk, but a magic-byte check at upload would be stricter.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (series list, detail, episode->series link, planner sidebar link)

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_i7_cover series created by test_full_cover_art_flow; deleted at the end of the test (and media folder removed). plan_items snapshot/restore handled by conftest.py — real Psalms membership of episode e625d168 is restored after the suite. Post-test DB state verified: 3 series, 2 Psalms plan_items, gemini_api_key length 53.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py -n 0 -v` (NEVER with xdist for destructive series/plan_items tests). The suite uses the real imported episode e625d168 ('Our Refuge and Strength') because it is the only published episode with feed artwork; conftest.py restores its membership in 'The Most Popular Psalms' after the run. For brainstorm 400, provider='openai' is used because no OpenAI key is configured — don't swap to gemini without temporarily removing the real key. Series list projection {_id:0, artwork.messages:0, artwork.concepts:0} is enforced in planner.list_series.
